name: codex-long-term-memory
description: Cross-thread conversation memory for Codex using hooks, AGENTS.md transport, and model-backed summaries.

interface.shortDescription: Install and manage Codex hook-based conversation memory.
interface.longDescription: Adds Codex hooks that log prompts, replies, and file context into local history, compacts history hierarchically, refreshes summaries in the background when model calls fail, and injects cross-thread context through hooks or a marked AGENTS.md block.
